findings.sourceEvidence: (k) Indebtedness of any Foreign Subsidiary or Foreign Subsidiary Holdco to the Parent Borrower or any other Subsidiary (so long as no Default or Event of Default shall have occurred and be continuing at the time of the incurrence of such Indebtedness); provided that (i) the requirements of Section 6.9 are satisfied and (ii) the aggregate principal amount of such Indebtedness at any time outstanding shall not exceed the greater of (A) $150,000,000 and (B) 10.0% of Consolidated Total Tangible Assets (measured on the date of incurrence of such Indebtedness); provided, further, that any Indebtedness permitted by this Section 7.2(k) shall be evidenced by a note or similar instrument and pledged in accordance with Section 6.9 and the Guarantee and Collateral Agreement;
findings.verifierReasoning: The proposed IR presents a self-contained PERMISSION to INCUR_DEBT conditioned solely on satisfaction of Section 6.9. In the source, clause 7.2(k)(i) is only one conjunctive requirement within the 7.2(k) exception. The permission is also conditioned on no Default or Event of Default being continuing at incurrence, on the aggregate principal cap in clause (ii) (the greater of $150,000,000 and 10.0% of Consolidated Total Tangible Assets), and on the 'provided, further' requirement that the debt be evidenced by a note or similar instrument and pledged in accordance with Section 6.9 and the Guarantee and Collateral Agreement. None of those conditions or the capacity expression is represented. Because the IR states an INCUR_DEBT permission with capacityExpression null, a competent reviewer using the IR alone could conclude that debt is permitted once Section 6.9 is satisfied, regardless of amount, existing default, or pledge/documentation requirements. The MISSING_CONTEXT label only discloses the unknown substance of Section 6.9; it does not disclose these known omissions, so it does not cure the materiality of the gap.

findings.verifierReasoning: The source carve-out is expressly limited to Indebtedness of any Foreign Subsidiary or Foreign Subsidiary Holdco owed to the Parent Borrower or any other Subsidiary. The proposed IR's INCUR_DEBT permission has an empty entityScope and no dependency or parent reference indicating that this scope is inherited from elsewhere. As proposed, the IR therefore does not represent the debtor/creditor scope of the permission. A reviewer could wrongly apply the permission to a different obligor or creditor relationship. This changes the scope of permitted activity and is material.
